target: EXP-481 follow-on: (1) bare-69 source regression test + one remaining templateable site (ISS-2411); (2) three-class breakdown templating via dome_claimed_refined=4 (ISS-2415); (3) WIN-061 SC monitoring two-layer classification precision (ISS-2445)
tldr_evidence: EXP-481 (integrated 2026-05-31) replaced 16+ bare '69' dome-count references in sections.json with {{DOME_CONFIRMED_HEADLINE}}. ISS-2411: The curmudgeon's suggested test (grep \b69\b in docs/index.html; assert count matches whitelist) is not appropriate — {{DOME_CONFIRMED_HEADLINE}} resolves TO 69 in rendered HTML, producing 52 hits that are all correct. The right gate is a source-level test on sections.json. Post-patch bare-69 count in non-meta sections.json is 12 (down from 13), all legitimately stay-literal. One additional site ('69-WIN headline count') was also templateable and has been fixed. ISS-2415: After EXP-481 added dome_claimed_confirmed, 2/3 of the three-class plumbing existed. This patch adds dome_claimed_refined=4 + wires {{DOME_REFINED_COUNT}}, completing the template. ISS-2445: EXP-489 classified WIN-061 as purely 'observational' but WIN-061 has a derivational layer (~22 Hz dome prediction vs 7.83 Hz observed) that is visible from the dome's own H(r) formula without live monitoring. The SC paragraph has been updated to acknowledge the two-layer structure.

patches.title: WIN-061 SC monitoring paragraph: acknowledge two-layer derivational+observational structure
patches.old_string: only the single empirical-prediction case (WIN-061, Schumann storm suppression) would actually be exposed by monitoring
patches.new_string: WIN-061 (Schumann storm suppression) is a mixed two-layer case: its baseline frequency contradiction (dome geometry predicts ~22 Hz via H_eff averaging vs observed 7.83 Hz) is derivational and visible from the dome's own H(r) formula; its V51.1 replacement claim (≥30% amplitude suppression within 6 hours of a G3 storm) is empirical and monitoring-dependent
patches.description: EXP-489 classified WIN-061 as purely 'observational' (the 1/12 exception in the SC bucket). But WIN-061's primary self-contradiction — dome cavity predicts ~22 Hz baseline, not 7.83 Hz — is derivational (see WIN-061 detail_evidence and WIN-038 for the pole-only floor). The V51.1 suppression claim is genuinely empirical, but calling WIN-061 a pure observational case misrepresents the two-layer structure.

notes_on_iss_2411_count.reason_not_to_test_rendered_html: {{DOME_CONFIRMED_HEADLINE}} resolves to the value 69 at render time. Testing the rendered count is circular — it would assert the right VALUE shows up, not that it's being generated from the right SOURCE. If dome_claimed_confirmed were updated to 70, the rendered HTML count would shift significantly and the test would need updating for the wrong reason.
notes_on_iss_2411_count.note: After P1 (templates '69-WIN headline count') and P2 (templates three-class breakdown), 12 remain. If ISS-2415 is integrated separately, the three-class item drops, bringing it to 11. Test ceiling is ≤12 to be safe across either integration order.
